title: UP Learning License Online Form 2020
organization: Transport Department, Uttar Pradesh / Parivahan Sewa
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in
2. Select Uttar Pradesh
3. Apply for Learner Licence
4. Fill form, upload photo/docs, book slot
5. Appear for online LL test if required
shortDescription: UP Learning License Online Form – apply for Learner’s Licence on sarathi.parivahan.gov.in (Uttar Pradesh).
content:
Learner’s Licence in Uttar Pradesh is applied online through Parivahan Sarathi.

Applicants select UP RTO, fill Form details, pay fee, and complete the learner test. After LL, permanent driving licence can be applied after the waiting period as per MV Act rules.
